name: crossmodel
description: Delegate work from Claude Code to an external agentic CLI — OpenAI Codex, or OpenCode for OpenRouter, Ollama and anything OpenAI-compatible — spending that provider's quota instead of your Anthropic quota. They sweep your repo and write code in a scope you bound; you review and commit. Ships a deterministic benchmark so you route by evidence, a saver mode for when your quota is nearly spent, and a permission policy that keeps git history yours.
